'''Athega''' was the primary star of the [[Athega system]].

A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] convoy [[Athega (corvette group)|of the same name]] consisting of eleven [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] was [[Battle near Athega|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in a neutral system near Athega during [[Operation: Quick Strike]] at the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref>
